You start small and grow your business by upgrading equipment, buying bigger boats and hiring crew. Licensed sonar equipment helps you find fish, and weather and seasons affect your work. It is a calm, detailed single-player sim for anyone curious about life at sea.
408520:
FORM is a virtual reality puzzle adventure where puzzles are built from dreams and memories. You investigate an ancient artifact and move through a world that transforms around you as you solve each puzzle.

The game uses VR to let you manipulate strange machines and shapes with your hands, and its visuals and music create a surreal mood. It is a short single-player experience. You will need a VR headset to play, and it suits players who like puzzle games with a mysterious atmosphere.
2483190:
Forza Horizon 6 is an open-world racing game from Playground Games set in Japan. You explore varied landscapes, take part in races and events, and work your way to becoming a racing legend at the Horizon festival.

There are more than 550 real-world cars to collect and customize, with racing that suits both casual and serious drivers. You can race alone, team up with friends or compete online. It is the biggest Forza Horizon world yet and a strong choice for anyone who loves cars and open-world driving.
4000:
Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox with no set goals. You get tools to spawn objects, characters and vehicles, weld them together and build whatever you can imagine, from silly contraptions to elaborate scenes.

The real heart of the game is its community. Players have created countless game modes, such as Trouble in Terrorist Town and Prop Hunt, along with maps and addons on the Steam Workshop. It works best with friends online. It is a legendary playground for creativity and chaos.
596620:
Gas Guzzlers - Combat Carnage is a fast-paced combat racing game. You drive armed cars around tracks, using weapons, upgrades and on-track bonuses to take out rivals and win races.

Different modes include classic races, deathmatches and capture the flag, and you can earn money to buy better cars and upgrades. The arcade action is chaotic and fun. It offers single-player and online multiplayer, and suits players who want a mix of racing and car combat.
735290:
Genesis Noir is a noir adventure spanning time and space. When a love triangle between cosmic beings turns bitter, a jealous god fires a gunshot, known as the Big Bang. You play No Man, who jumps into the expanding universe to find a way to stop the bullet.

The game is a series of interactive scenes, each with striking black-and-white art and a jazz soundtrack. You solve light puzzles and explore moments from across history. It is a unique single-player experience for players who appreciate art, music and unusual storytelling.
322170:
Geometry Dash is a rhythm-based action platformer. You guide a small block through levels full of spikes and obstacles, jumping and flying in time with the music.

Levels are tough and require precise timing, but they are short and fun to replay. The game includes a level editor, and players have shared millions of custom levels. It suits players who like quick, challenging games and a strong sense of rhythm.
1593500:
God of War is an action adventure from Santa Monica Studio. Years after his vengeance against the gods of Olympus, Kratos lives in the realm of Norse gods and monsters, and must fight to survive while teaching his son Atreus to do the same.

Combat centers on the Leviathan Axe, which can be thrown and recalled, and Atreus helps in battle. The world opens up as you travel through realms, solve puzzles and uncover secrets. It won many Game of the Year awards and is a must-play for fans of story-driven action.
1432910:
Godlike Burger is a dark comedy restaurant management game. You run the craziest restaurant in the galaxy, where alien customers keep coming back for more, as long as you are smart about which ones end up in the burgers.

You stun, poison and dispose of customers in devious ways while cooking, upgrading your restaurant and keeping suspicion low. Each run brings new challenges and upgrades. It is a single-player game with a twisted sense of humor, and suits players who enjoy fast-paced management games with a twist.
3240220:
Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced is the upgraded version of Rockstar's open-world crime blockbuster. You follow three criminals, Michael, Franklin and Trevor, through a story of heists and betrayal in the city of Los Santos and its surroundings.

This edition adds improved visuals, faster loading, 3D audio and other upgrades for modern PCs. It also includes Grand Theft Auto Online, with exclusive content for the enhanced version. It is one of the best-selling games of all time and a great way to experience the series on PC.
206190:
Gunpoint is a stealth puzzle game where you play a freelance spy who breaks into high-security buildings to steal data. Your main tool is the Crosslink, which lets you rewire the electronics in each level to trick guards and open paths.

You can pounce on guards, leap long distances and find creative solutions to each job. Levels are short, and the writing is witty. It suits players who like stealth and puzzle games with lots of freedom to experiment.
1145360:
Hades is a roguelike dungeon crawler from Supergiant Games. You play Zagreus, son of Hades, who fights his way out of the Underworld with help from the gods of Olympus.

Each escape attempt is different, with powerful boons from the gods and weapons to choose from. When you die, you return home, where characters remember your progress and the story moves forward. It won many awards and is praised for its combat, art, music and voice acting.
1145350:
Hades II is the sequel to Supergiant Games' award-winning roguelike. You play Melinoe, the Princess of the Underworld, who uses dark sorcery to battle her way beyond the Underworld and take on the Titan of Time.

New weapons, spells and boons from the gods of Olympus create endless combinations, and you grow stronger between runs. The story unfolds as you try again and again. It keeps the fast combat and rich storytelling that made the first game a hit.
1206060:
Happy Game is a psychedelic horror adventure from Amanita Design. A little boy falls asleep and finds himself in a horrible nightmare, and you must help him get through it so he can be happy again.

The game uses Amanita's signature hand-drawn style and puzzle design, but with a dark and unsettling twist, with cute imagery hiding disturbing content. It is short and best for players who enjoy creative puzzles and are not put off by strange and creepy themes.
394360:
Hearts of Iron IV is a grand strategy game from Paradox set during World War II. You take command of any nation and guide it through the conflict, managing its economy, military and diplomacy.

You can design your own tanks, ships and planes, plan battles and decide which side to join. Historical events and alternate history paths make every playthrough different. It supports single-player and multiplayer, and suits players who love deep strategy and history.
268130:
Heat Signature is a game from the makers of Gunpoint where you break into spaceships. You take a mission, fly to the target ship, sneak inside and use clever gadgets to distract, avoid or take out guards.

Each ship is procedurally generated, so no two missions are alike. Things often go wrong, and the fun comes from improvising your way out. You can play as many characters, each with their own goals. It is a single-player game for players who like creative stealth and action.
1620730:
Hell Is Us is an action adventure from Rogue Factor. In an isolated country torn apart by civil war, you explore to uncover the secrets of your past and deal with the effects of a mysterious calamity.

The game encourages real exploration, with no map or quest markers to guide you, so you rely on clues and your own observations. Combat is melee-focused, and you face strange creatures born from the calamity. It suits players who like atmospheric games and figuring things out for themselves.
553850:
HELLDIVERS 2 is a co-op third-person shooter from Arrowhead Game Studios. You join the Helldivers, an elite force fighting for freedom across a hostile galaxy against alien and robotic enemies.

Up to four players drop onto planets to complete missions, calling in powerful stratagems like air strikes and supply drops. Friendly fire is always on, so teamwork and coordination matter. The galactic war evolves based on community progress. It is chaotic and best played with friends.
367520:
Hollow Knight is an action adventure from Team Cherry set in Hallownest, a vast ruined kingdom of insects. You explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and meet strange bugs in a classic hand-drawn 2D style.

You gain new abilities to reach new areas, and the world is full of secrets and challenging bosses. Charms let you customize your play. It is a highly praised metroidvania with tight combat and a haunting atmosphere, and a must-play for fans of the genre.
1030300:
Hollow Knight: Silksong is the sequel to Team Cherry's acclaimed action adventure. You play Hornet, princess-protector of Hallownest, who is taken to a new kingdom ruled by silk and song and must climb to its peak.

Hornet moves fast and fights with acrobatic attacks and silken tools. The world is huge, full of quests, secrets and tough bosses. It keeps the hand-drawn style and haunting music of the original. It is one of the most anticipated indie games of recent years.
2051120:
HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Turbocharged is an arcade racing game from Milestone. You race over 130 Hot Wheels vehicles, including new types like motorbikes and ATVs, across wild tracks with loops and jumps.

New mechanics like dashes and jumps add to the action, and you can build your own tracks in new environments. There are single-player modes and online races against other players. It suits players of all ages who want fast, fun racing.
219150:
Hotline Miami is a high-octane top-down action game set in 1989 Miami. You receive mysterious phone calls telling you to go to certain places, where you wear an animal mask and take out everyone inside.

Combat is fast and brutal, as one hit can kill you or your enemies, so you need quick reactions and planning. The neon visuals and pulsing soundtrack add to its intensity. It is short but replayable, and a cult classic of the genre.
4001890:
How to Fish is a physics-based fishing simulator for 1 to 4 players. After crashing your boat into a small island while out drinking and boating, you have to learn how to fish to make your way back home.

Fishing uses physics, so casting and reeling can be both tricky and funny, especially with friends in co-op. You upgrade your gear and explore as you go. Released in August 2026, it suits players who want a light, silly game to enjoy with friends.
594650:
Hunt: Showdown 1896 is an extraction shooter from Crytek. You take bounties in corrupted backwaters, tracking monsters and fighting other players to claim the rewards and escape alive.

Up to 12 players compete in each match, solo or in teams, and if your hunter dies, they are gone for good with their gear. Sound and careful play are crucial. The game uses 19th-century weapons and an atmospheric setting. It suits players who want a tense, rewarding PvP experience.
553640:
ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action game that is also a meta game in disguise. You play ICEY, guided by a narrator who constantly urges you in one direction, but you can choose to ignore him.

Combat is fast and stylish, with combos and upgrades. The real fun comes from defying the narrator and discovering hidden content and secrets. It is short and funny, and suits players who like games that play with expectations.
2221920:
Immortals Fenyx Rising is an open-world action adventure from Ubisoft. You play Fenyx, a demigod on a quest to save the Greek gods from the monster Typhon.

You explore the Golden Isle, solve puzzles, fight mythical creatures and gain powers from the gods. The tone is humorous, with narration from Zeus and Prometheus. It suits players who enjoy exploration, puzzles and a lighthearted take on mythology.
1184480:
Inertial Drift is an arcade racing game with innovative twin-stick controls. One stick steers, and the other controls drifting, letting you slide through corners in a way unlike most racers.

There are many unique cars and tracks, each with its own feel, plus a story mode and challenges. It takes practice to master but feels great once it clicks. It is a single-player game that suits players who love arcade racing and want something fresh.
1016770:
Interrogation: You Will Be Deceived is a detective game where you fight a dangerous terrorist group. You interrogate suspects to uncover information while managing your team and its reputation.

You can use manipulation, threats or worse to get answers, but every choice affects public opinion and the investigation. Time is short, and the story raises questions about how far you should go. It suits players who like narrative games with tough choices.
1426210:
It Takes Two is a co-op adventure from Hazelight Studios. Cody and May, a couple on the verge of divorce, are turned into dolls and must work together to get back to their bodies.

The game must be played by two players, either online or local, and only one needs to own it thanks to the Friend's Pass. Each level brings new mechanics and challenges, so you are always trying something different. It won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2021.
1132910:
ITORAH is a 2D action platformer set in the world of Nahucan. You play Itorah, the only human in this strange place, who sets out with her talking axe to uncover her past and save Nahucan from a mysterious plague.

You explore a hand-painted world, fight enemies and bosses, and unlock new abilities to reach new areas. Combat is demanding, with dodging and timing playing a big role. It is a single-player game with lovely art and a touching story.
255300:
Journey of a Roach is a point-and-click adventure set after a nuclear war. Mutated insects live in a bomb shelter, and two cockroaches named Jim and Bud set out to explore the world above.

You climb walls and ceilings, solve puzzles and meet strange creatures in a bizarre and funny post-apocalyptic world. There is no dialogue, only expressive animations. It is a short, charming single-player game for fans of classic adventures.
379430:
Kingdom Come: Deliverance is a story-driven open-world role-playing game set in the Holy Roman Empire in 1403. You play Henry, a blacksmith's son who sets out to avenge his parents' death as invading forces sweep through Bohemia.

The game focuses on realism, with detailed combat, skills that improve with use and needs like eating and sleeping. Quests can be solved in many ways, and choices matter. It suits players who want an immersive medieval adventure without fantasy elements.
3093400:
Knightica is a roguelike autobattler where you guide a warband through challenges to free the kingdoms. You recruit units, place them on the battlefield and watch them fight automatically.

The strategy is in building your army, finding unit synergies and using enchantments to make them stronger. Each run is different, with new combinations to discover. It is a single-player game for players who like planning and seeing their strategies play out.
550:
Left 4 Dead 2 is a co-op action horror first-person shooter from Valve. You and three friends fight through the zombie apocalypse across five campaigns, traveling from Savannah to New Orleans through cities, swamps and cemeteries.

The AI Director changes enemy placement and items each time you play, so every run feels different. Special infected force you to work together. Versus mode lets players take control of the infected, and the Steam Workshop adds countless custom campaigns. It remains one of the best co-op shooters.
3747730:
Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered is a remastered version of the 2003 action adventure. You play both the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel as their paths collide across the dark world of Nosgoth.

You wield legendary blades, use supernatural abilities and fight through a world of conflict and prophecy. The remaster updates the visuals while keeping the original's story and voice acting. It suits longtime fans and newcomers curious about this classic series.
207170:
Legend of Grimrock is a dungeon crawling role-playing game inspired by old-school classics. You lead a party of four prisoners who are thrown into Mount Grimrock and must find their way out.

Movement is grid-based, but combat happens in real time, so you need quick reactions as well as strategy. The dungeon is full of puzzles, traps and secrets. A dungeon editor lets you build and share your own adventures. It suits fans of classic RPGs who enjoy exploration and challenge.
313810:
Legend of Kay Anniversary is a remastered version of the action adventure released ten years earlier. You play Kay, a young cat who stands up against the gorillas and rats who have taken over his homeland of Yenwood.

Kay fights with martial arts and weapons, explores colorful worlds and solves light puzzles. The remaster brings high-resolution textures, detailed character models and improved sound. It suits players who enjoy classic 3D action adventures with a lighthearted tone.
213330:
LEGO Batman 2: DC Super Heroes is an action adventure from TT Games. Batman and Robin team up with other DC heroes like Superman, Wonder Woman and Green Lantern to save Gotham City from Lex Luthor and the Joker.

For the first time in the series, characters have full voice acting, and Gotham is an open world you can explore freely. Each hero has unique abilities, and you can unlock dozens of characters. It is fun for all ages, especially fans of DC and LEGO games.
829110:
LEGO DC Super-Villains is an action adventure from TT Games where you play as the bad guys. You create your own super-villain and team up with DC's most famous villains as they take on an imposter group of heroes.

You can explore open areas like Gotham and Metropolis, unlock a huge roster of characters and play with a friend in local co-op. The humor and building make it fun for all ages. It suits fans of DC and anyone who has ever wanted to be the villain.
21130:
LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4 is an action adventure from TT Games. You relive the first four Harry Potter stories in LEGO style, from Privet Drive to the Triwizard Tournament.

You explore Hogwarts, learn spells, brew potions and solve puzzles with the help of many characters. The humor and charm make it fun for kids and adults alike. It is a great pick for Harry Potter fans who want a lighthearted way to experience the stories.
204120:
LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7 is an action adventure from Traveller's Tales. It takes you through Harry's final years at Hogwarts and the battle against Voldemort, in classic LEGO style.

You explore Hogwarts and the wizarding world, cast spells, solve puzzles and unlock many characters. The humor keeps things light even as the story gets darker. It completes the LEGO Harry Potter adventure and is fun for all ages.
785847:
LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga Galactic Edition is the complete version of TT Games' LEGO Star Wars adventure. It covers all nine Skywalker saga films, letting you play through the story from The Phantom Menace to The Rise of Skywalker in any order.

This edition includes the base game plus extra character packs, adding dozens of extra characters from other Star Wars stories. You can explore planets, fly in space and unlock hundreds of characters. It is fun for all ages and a great pick for Star Wars fans.
214510:
LEGO The Lord of the Rings is an action adventure from Traveller's Tales. It follows the story of the three films, from The Fellowship of the Ring to The Return of the King, in LEGO style.

The game uses dialogue from the films and lets you explore an open Middle-earth between story missions. You can unlock many characters, each with special abilities, and find secrets everywhere. It is fun for all ages and a great way to experience the trilogy.
1966720:
Lethal Company is a co-op horror game where you scavenge abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company. You and your crew must meet a profit quota or face the consequences.

Each moon is full of dangerous creatures, and you must work together and communicate with proximity voice chat. Things often go wrong in hilarious and terrifying ways. It is in Early Access and best played with friends. It became a hit for its mix of fear and fun.
554620:
Life is Strange: Before The Storm is a standalone story adventure set three years before the first Life is Strange. You play Chloe Price, a rebellious teenager who forms an unlikely friendship with Rachel Amber.

Choices shape relationships and the story, and the Backtalk system lets Chloe use her sharp tongue to win arguments. The story deals with grief, friendship and family. It is a single-player game for fans of emotional, choice-driven narratives.
2072450:
Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth is a role-playing game from RGG Studio. Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu team up in an adventure spanning Japan and Hawaii.

Combat is turn-based but dynamic, with characters able to move around and use the environment. The game is full of side activities, including a creature collecting game and an island resort to manage. It mixes drama and humor and suits fans of the series and newcomers alike.
1924360:
Lil' Guardsman is a narrative puzzle game where you play Lil, a 12-year-old girl suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate. You decide whether elves, goblins and over 100 other characters should be let in.

You use deduction, tools and gadgets to question visitors and uncover the truth. Choices affect the story and the kingdom. The humor and colorful art make it fun for all ages. It suits players who enjoy puzzles and stories with lots of character.
574720:
Little Big Workshop is a factory management game set on a tabletop. You manage workers, stations and machines to create products and grow your workshop into a dream factory.

You take orders, plan production lines and expand your space as your business grows. The charming tabletop style makes it relaxing. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy management games with a light touch.
2236680:
Llamasoft: The Jeff Minter Story is an interactive documentary from Digital Eclipse. It explores the life and work of Jeff Minter, the legendary creator of Attack of the Mutant Camels, Gridrunner and Tempest 2000.

The game includes 42 of his games, along with interviews, documents and artwork. It is a mix of history and play, showing the evolution of game design through one creator's eyes. It suits retro fans and anyone curious about gaming history.
2058190:
Lost Judgment is an action adventure from RGG Studio. Detective Takayuki Yagami goes undercover at a high school in Yokohama to unravel a string of twisted crimes.

Combat uses three fighting styles, Crane, Tiger and Snake, each suited to different situations. The game also has many side stories and activities, including school clubs. It suits fans of crime dramas and action games with lots of content.
791240:
Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles is a 3D puzzle platformer. You play Lumote, a squishy bioluminescent creature, on a quest into the Great Depths to seize control from the Mastermote.

You take control of the world's inhabitants by changing their colors, solving puzzles as you go. The underwater world is beautiful and calm. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy puzzles and relaxing exploration.
40700:
Machinarium is an award-winning adventure from Amanita Design. You play Josef, a little robot who sets out to save his girlfriend Berta from the Black Cap Brotherhood gang.

There is no dialogue, only hand-drawn art, expressive animations and a beautiful soundtrack. You solve puzzles by interacting with the world and combining items. It is a classic of the genre and suits players of all ages.
234140:
Mad Max is an open-world action game from Avalanche Studios. You play Max, a survivor who wants to escape the madness of the Wasteland but must fight to survive.

You build and upgrade your car, the Magnum Opus, and use it in vehicle combat across the desert. On foot, you fight with brutal hand-to-hand combat. The world is huge, with camps to clear and resources to find. It suits players who love car combat and post-apocalyptic settings.
1030840:
Mafia: Definitive Edition is a remake of the classic crime game from Hangar 13. Cab driver Tommy Angelo has a brush with the mob in the 1930s city of Lost Heaven and is drawn into the world of organized crime.

The game is story-driven, with shootouts, car chases and missions for the Salieri family. The remake has new visuals, voice acting and expanded story elements. It suits players who enjoy cinematic crime stories.
1088850:
Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy is an action adventure from Eidos-Montreal. You play Star-Lord, leading the unpredictable Guardians through a wild ride across the cosmos.

You fight with your blasters and give orders to your teammates, and choices in conversations affect the story. The writing and humor are highlights, along with an 80s soundtrack. It is a single-player game for fans of Marvel and story-driven action.
1817070:
Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered is an action adventure from Insomniac Games. You play an experienced Peter Parker, who has been Spider-Man for eight years, fighting big crime and iconic villains across a detailed Marvel's New York.

Web-swinging between skyscrapers feels fast and fluid, and combat mixes acrobatics, gadgets and stealth takedowns. The story balances Peter's personal life with his duties as a hero, and side activities fill the city. This version includes The City That Never Sleeps story content. It is a must-play for superhero fans.
1337530:
Maskmaker is a virtual reality adventure from the makers of A Fisherman's Tale. You play an apprentice to a maskmaker, learning to craft masks that let you enter the minds of mysterious beings.

You explore diverse worlds, gather materials and solve puzzles. The game uses VR to let you craft and interact with objects in a hands-on way. You will need a VR headset to play. It suits players who like immersive, story-driven puzzle games.
2024390:
Mato Anomalies is a role-playing game set in a neo-futuristic version of an old oriental city called Mato. You follow a detective and an exorcist who investigate strange happenings across the city and uncover the secrets hidden behind its walls.

Combat is turn-based, with a cast of unusual heroes who each bring their own skills, and some confrontations play out as card-based mind battles. The story is told with an anime-inspired style and plenty of noir atmosphere. It is a single-player game for fans of story-heavy Japanese-style RPGs.
12150:
Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne is a violent film-noir love story from Remedy Entertainment. NYPD detective Max Payne is pulled back into a world of crime and corruption, and crosses paths again with the mysterious Mona Sax.

Combat is built around Bullet Time, letting you slow down the action and dive through rooms in stylish gunfights, with physics that make every shootout feel dramatic. The dark, tragic story is told through graphic novel panels. It is a single-player classic for fans of cinematic action games.
204100:
Max Payne 3 is a third-person shooter from Rockstar. No longer a New York City cop, Max Payne moves to Sao Paulo to protect a wealthy family, hoping to finally escape his troubled past, but things quickly go wrong.

Bullet Time returns, along with a cover system and detailed shooting that make every gunfight feel heavy and intense. The story is dark and cinematic, with a gritty look at Max's struggles. This complete edition includes all previously released extra content. It suits fans of story-driven action.
244450:
Men of War: Assault Squad 2 is a real-time tactics game set in World War II. You command infantry, tanks and artillery across five factions, with detailed units that can take cover, use equipment and fight realistically.

Direct Control lets you take over any unit and aim and drive yourself. There are 65 maps, hundreds of vehicles and soldiers, skirmish missions and massive multiplayer battles, including co-op. It suits players who want a deep and demanding WWII tactics game.
990380:
METAL EDEN is a fast-paced sci-fi first-person shooter from Reikon Games, makers of Ruiner. You play Aska, a Hyper Unit sent on a suicide mission to rescue the stored cores of citizens from Moebius, an orbital city that has become a deadly trap.

Combat is fast and acrobatic, mixing gunplay with movement such as wall running and dashes, and you can rip enemy cores out to use them. Along the way you uncover the secrets of Moebius and face its Engineers. It is a single-player game for fans of high-speed shooters.
287390:
Metro: Last Light Redux is a first-person shooter set in 2034, beneath the ruins of post-apocalyptic Moscow. You play Artyom, a Ranger trying to protect the remnants of humanity living in the Metro tunnels from mutants and rival factions.

The game mixes stealth, survival and horror, with scarce ammo, gas masks and a tense atmosphere. This Redux version improves the visuals and includes all extra content, plus the challenging Ranger mode. It is a single-player game for fans of story-driven shooters.
648168:
Middle-earth: The Shadow Bundle brings together both Middle-earth action adventures from Monolith, Shadow of Mordor and Shadow of War. You play Talion, a ranger bound to the spirit of the elf lord Celebrimbor, who takes the fight to Sauron's armies in Mordor.

Both games use the Nemesis System, which turns orc enemies into unique rivals who remember your encounters and grow stronger. Shadow of War adds fortress sieges and building your own orc army. Combat is fluid and brutal. It suits fans of open-world action and The Lord of the Rings.
544970:
Milkmaid of the Milky Way is an award-winning point-and-click adventure told entirely in rhyme. In 1920s Norway, Ruth, a young milkmaid living alone on a farm by a fjord, sees a strange alien craft, and her quiet life is turned upside down.

The story mixes heartfelt themes with puzzles and exploration, and the pixel art and music create a lovely atmosphere. It is short, sweet and suitable for all ages. It suits players who enjoy classic adventures and charming storytelling.
609490:
Minit is a peculiar little adventure played sixty seconds at a time. You pick up a cursed sword that makes you die every minute, so you have to explore, solve puzzles and find items in short bursts before starting again.

Progress carries over between lives, and you learn shortcuts and secrets to get further each time. The black-and-white art and clever design make it surprising and fun. It is short and charming, a great fit for players who like puzzles and unusual ideas.
1049710:
Minute of Islands is a narrative puzzle platformer. You guide Mo, a young mechanic, on a quest to repair a world on the brink of collapse, exploring strange islands and the dark labyrinths beneath them.

Using the Omni Switch, Mo restarts giant machines that keep the islands alive, but the story touches on heavy themes of family and responsibility. The hand-drawn art is beautiful, and the narration is gentle. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy story-driven experiences.
1610460:
Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 5 is a racing game from Milestone based on the indoor supercross championship. You compete on official tracks with licensed riders and bikes.

Career mode lets you build your rider's skills and reputation, and a track editor lets you create your own circuits. You can play alone or race online. It suits fans of motorsport and dirt bike racing.
2246340:
Monster Hunter Wilds is an action role-playing game from Capcom. You play a hunter exploring the Forbidden Lands, a world where environments change dramatically and monsters struggle to survive alongside humans.

You track and fight huge monsters, using their parts to craft weapons and armor. A mount called a Seikret lets you travel smoothly, and you can carry two weapons. You can hunt alone or with up to three friends online. It suits players who love epic boss fights and gear building.
5335510:
Moon Sweepers is a co-op game about cleaning an entire Moon, starting with just a toothbrush. You collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools and unlock cleaning vehicles to turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation.

It shines with friends, supporting teams of up to 16 players, though you can also play solo. The humor and progression make it easy to get hooked. Released in October 2026, it suits players who like silly co-op games and upgrade loops.
1658150:
Moonstone Island is a creature-collecting life sim set in an open world with 100 islands to explore. You arrive as a young alchemist and must complete your training while making friends and collecting Spirits.

You farm, brew potions, craft and decorate, and battles use a card-based system. Relationships with the islanders can grow into romance. It is a relaxing single-player game for fans of cozy life sims and monster collecting.
349270:
Mosaic is a narrative adventure about a lonely office worker in a cold, gray city. You go through your daily routine, commuting and working in a faceless corporation, while strange and surreal moments start to break through.

The game lasts about two to three hours and focuses on mood and story rather than challenge. It explores loneliness and the search for meaning in modern life. It suits players who enjoy thoughtful, artistic games.
1161490:
MotoGP20 is the official MotoGP game from Milestone. You race with real riders, teams and tracks from the 2020 season, and build a career in the Managerial mode, hiring staff and developing your bike.

The racing is realistic, with tire wear and fuel management, and you can customize your bike and suit. You can also race against legends from the sport's past or challenge friends online. It suits motorbike racing fans.
261550:
Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is a strategy action role-playing game set in a vast medieval sandbox. You create a character and rise from nothing, trading, crafting, engaging in diplomacy and conquering new lands.

You raise armies and fight alongside them in massive real-time battles and sieges, giving orders and fighting in first person. You can start a clan, join a kingdom or build your own. Mods add even more. It suits players who want freedom and large-scale medieval battles.
281750:
Munin is a 2D puzzle adventure inspired by Norse mythology. Munin, Odin's raven messenger, is turned into a girl by Loki and must travel through Yggdrasil, the world tree, to reclaim her power.

You solve puzzles by rotating sections of the world, which changes the path and the direction of gravity. Physics and runes add to the challenge. It is a single-player game with a hand-drawn look and gentle music.
1069530:
Narita Boy is an action adventure set inside the Digital Kingdom, a world inspired by 1980s computers. You play Narita Boy, a legendary pixel hero who wields the Techno-sword to battle corrupt programs called the Stallions.

Combat is fast and stylish, and the story unfolds through memories of the kingdom's creator. The retro visuals and synth soundtrack are standouts. It is a single-player game for fans of retro aesthetics and action platformers.
4356430:
NBA 2K27 is the 2026 edition of the long-running NBA 2K basketball series. You can create a player and chase greatness in MyCAREER, build a fantasy squad of stars past and present in MyTEAM, or run a franchise in MyNBA.

Quick games, online matches and co-op play round out the modes, and the presentation mirrors a real TV broadcast with commentary and replays. Rosters and ratings follow the current NBA season. It suits basketball fans who want the most complete and up-to-date hoops game available.
485510:
Nioh: Complete Edition is an action role-playing game from Team Ninja. You play William, a lone traveler who lands on the shores of Japan during the age of samurai, and must fight through warriors and supernatural Yokai.

Combat is tough and deep, with stances, weapons and a Ki system for managing stamina. You can summon other players for help in co-op. This edition includes all extra content. It suits players who enjoy challenging action games.
275850:
No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite, procedurally generated universe from Hello Games. You start stranded on an alien planet and must repair your ship, then travel between countless worlds, each with unique landscapes and creatures.

Years of free updates have transformed it, adding base building, freighters, settlements, multiplayer, story missions and much more. You can trade, fight pirates, catalog wildlife or just wander. Play alone or with friends online. It suits players who love exploration and open-ended sci-fi adventure.
287720:
Nostradamus: The Last Prophecy is a point-and-click adventure set in 16th century France. You play Madeleine, daughter of the famous seer Nostradamus, who investigates a series of strange events linked to his prophecies.

The game mixes historical settings with puzzles and supernatural elements. You explore, gather clues and talk to characters to uncover the truth. It is a single-player game for fans of classic adventures and history.
768450:
NUTS is a single-player surveillance mystery about squirrels. As a field researcher in Melmoth Forest, you set up cameras by day, review the footage by night and report your findings to a demanding boss.

Following the squirrels slowly reveals that something strange is happening in the forest, and the story unfolds through your observations and phone calls. The bold, flat colors give it a striking look, and the pace is calm. It is a short, unusual game for players who enjoy quiet mysteries.
1386900:
Observer: System Redux is a first-person cyberpunk horror detective story from Bloober Team. You play an Observer, a detective who hacks into people's minds, investigating a murder in a decaying future city.

You explore corrupted memories that twist reality, gather clues and confront your own fears. The Redux version improves the visuals and adds new content. It suits players who like psychological horror and detective stories.
597180:
Old World is a historical strategy game where you lead a dynasty over generations. You manage your court, build cities and wage wars against rival kings and queens.

Characters age and have traits, and their choices drive a story full of events. An orders system makes every turn a set of tough choices. You can play alone or online. It suits players who like 4X strategy with deep character stories.
1668190:
Once Upon a Jester is a comedy adventure about improvised theater. You play Jester, who travels the kingdom with his best friend Sok to perform shows on stages far and wide.

You improvise plays, sing songs and tell jokes to impress audiences, aiming to become the stars of the Royal Theatrical Spectacle. The tone is light and funny. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy silly, charming stories.
387290:
Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition is an action platformer from Moon Studios. It tells the tale of Ori, a young orphan destined for heroics, who sets out to save the dying forest of Nibel.

The hand-painted visuals and emotional soundtrack are famous, and movement and combat are smooth and precise. This version adds new areas and abilities. It suits fans of metroidvanias and beautiful games.
339850:
Overclocked: A History of Violence is a psychological thriller adventure. During a catastrophic thunderstorm in New York City, psychiatrist David McNamara investigates the case of several young people found confused and traumatized.

You question patients and relive their memories to uncover what happened, while exploring themes of violence. The story is dark and intense. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy mature, story-driven adventures.
1623730:
Palworld is a multiplayer open-world survival and crafting game from Pocketpair. You fight, farm, build and work alongside mysterious creatures called Pals.

Pals can fight, work at your base, travel with you and even be ridden. You build bases, craft weapons and explore a large world. You can play alone or with friends online. It became a huge hit for its mix of monster collecting and survival.
1227530:
Partisans 1941 is a real-time tactics game with stealth elements set on the Eastern Front of World War II. You lead a group of partisans behind enemy lines, fighting a guerrilla war against German occupiers.

You plan ambushes, sneak past patrols and use each partisan's skills. Between missions you manage your camp and supplies. It suits players who like tactical stealth games with a historical setting.
1347970:
Patch Quest is a roguelike metroidvania set in a labyrinth full of monsters. You rely on your Lasso to capture and tame any monster, then ride it to leap, glide, surf and tunnel through a patchwork maze.

Each run is different, but you keep progress, and the bullet-hell combat is tough. The art is bright and colorful. You can play alone or with a friend. It suits players who like creative roguelikes.
2694490:
Path of Exile 2 is a free-to-play action role-playing game from Grinding Gear Games. Set years after the original, you return to the dark world of Wraeclast to end a spreading corruption.

Combat is more deliberate than in many ARPGs, with dodge rolls and tough bosses. Character builds are deep, with a huge skill tree and gem system. You can play solo or in co-op with up to six players. It is in Early Access.
1687950:
Persona 5 Royal is a stylish turn-based role-playing game from Atlus. You lead the Phantom Thieves of Hearts, high school students who enter the hearts of corrupt adults to change their ways.

Days are split between school life in Tokyo, building friendships, and exploring dungeons called Palaces. Combat is turn-based and fast. Royal adds a new character, a new semester and many improvements. It is one of the most acclaimed RPGs ever made.
4115450:
Phantom Blade Zero is an action role-playing game from S-GAME, combining classic wuxia storytelling with fast action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live.

You fight assassins and uncover world-ending conspiracies with fluid, cinematic martial arts combat. The setting mixes ancient China with dark fantasy. Released in October 2026, it suits fans of challenging action games.
739630:
Phasmophobia is an online co-op psychological horror game for up to four players. You and your team are ghost hunters, using equipment to gather evidence and identify the type of ghost haunting each location.

Voice recognition lets ghosts hear you, and the atmosphere is tense. Each investigation plays out differently. It is in Early Access and best with friends. It became a hit for its scares and teamwork.
1436590:
Phoenotopia: Awakening is an action adventure puzzle platformer inspired by classic games. You play Gail, a young girl who sets out on a grand adventure to save her family after they are taken.

You explore towns and dungeons, solve puzzles, fight enemies and meet charming characters. The pixel art and music add to its charm. It is a single-player game with a big world and lots to discover.
1049280:
Pilgrims is a playful adventure from Amanita Design, the makers of Machinarium and Samorost. You roam the land, make new friends and help fellow travelers complete their little stories.

Puzzles are solved using a deck of cards that represent characters and items, and there are many ways to reach each solution. It is short and charming. It suits players of all ages who like relaxing adventures.
560130:
Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire is a role-playing game from Obsidian Entertainment and the sequel to the award-winning Pillars of Eternity. You play the Watcher, who chases a rogue god across the Deadfire Archipelago aboard your own ship.

You gather companions, explore islands, make choices that shape the factions of the region and fight in tactical battles, now with an optional turn-based mode. Ship combat, upgrades and naval exploration add variety. It suits fans of classic party RPGs in the style of Baldur's Gate.
105800:
PixelJunk Eden is an organic platformer from Q-Games. You play a tiny Grimp who swings, climbs and jumps through massive gardens of vibrant other-worldly plant life, popping pollen pods to grow new plants and reach higher.

The goal in each garden is to collect glowing spectra before your time runs out, and the electronic soundtrack and abstract visuals give it a hypnotic feel. It is easy to start but takes skill to master. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy creative, relaxing platforming.
334310:
Plebby Quest: The Crusades is a medieval strategy sandbox with a sense of humor. You rule a small realm during the Crusades, surviving ambitious rulers dreaming of empire, treacherous neighbors who want to burn your lands and the church's unreasonable demands.

You manage your lands, armies, diplomacy and faith, while random events and odd characters keep things unpredictable. Every campaign plays out differently depending on your choices. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy medieval strategy that does not take itself too seriously.
620:
Portal 2 is a puzzle game from Valve. You return to Aperture Science, where the AI GLaDOS and a new companion named Wheatley guide you through new test chambers.

You use the portal gun to solve physics puzzles, with new tools like gels and light bridges. A separate co-op campaign features two robots, and the Perpetual Testing Initiative lets you create and share puzzles. It is one of the best puzzle games ever made.
2132890:
Possessor(s) is a fast-paced action side-scroller from Heart Machine, the makers of Hyper Light Drifter. You play a young woman who survives a disaster by bonding with a demon, and the pair explore a ruined city full of dangerous characters.

Combat is inspired by platform fighters, with juggles, combos and a wide range of weapons. You explore a deep interconnected world to find new abilities. It suits fans of stylish metroidvanias.
13530:
Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones is the final chapter of the Sands of Time trilogy. The Prince returns to Babylon with Kaileena, but finds his homeland ravaged by war and himself pursued by a dark alter ego.

You switch between the Prince and the Dark Prince, using acrobatic moves and speed kills to defeat enemies. Time powers let you rewind mistakes. It is a single-player classic for fans of action platforming.
233450:
Prison Architect is a prison building and management game from Introversion Software. You design and run your own penitentiary, building cells, canteens, workshops and yards, and hiring guards and staff.

Prisoners need food, safety and things to do, or tension rises and riots and escapes follow. You can run reform programs or rule with an iron fist. A story mode teaches the basics, and a sandbox lets you build freely. It suits players who enjoy management games with dark humor.
4411720:
Pro Basketball Manager 2027 is a management game that puts you in charge of a basketball club. You oversee every part of its development, from building the roster and scouting emerging talent to shaping the tactics that define how your team plays.

Young prospects can be developed into future stars, while trades, contracts and finances test your long-term planning. Matches are simulated, so your decisions before and during games are what matter. Released in November 2026, it is a single-player game for basketball fans who enjoy deep, numbers-driven management.
4348910:
Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set on a dystopian space station. You run a small shop where you craft, trade and smuggle goods of questionable origin, trying to earn enough to keep the doors open.

Rival factions want your loyalty, and every deal can win friends or make enemies. You decide how far you are willing to bend the rules, and those choices shape your story and the station around you. Released in October 2026, it suits players who like management games with a gritty setting and moral gray areas.
423580:
Project Highrise is a skyscraper construction and management sim from SomaSim. You build a tower floor by floor and fill it with offices, shops, restaurants and apartments, then work to keep your tenants happy and your building profitable.

Every tenant has needs, from electricity and water to phone lines and services like cleaning, and unhappy tenants leave. Planning elevators, utilities and layouts turns each building into a puzzle. There are scenarios with goals as well as a sandbox mode. It suits players who enjoy detailed, calm management games.
108600:
Project Zomboid is a hardcore zombie survival game set in an infested region of Kentucky. The game opens by telling you this is how you died, and the question is how long you can last before that happens.

You loot houses, barricade windows, craft, farm, fish and fight while managing hunger, injuries, illness and even boredom. Skills improve slowly with practice, and the large map rewards careful planning. A customizable sandbox and active modding scene add replay value, and you can survive alone or online with friends.
394310:
Punch Club is a boxing management game with a story. You train a young fighter, manage his money, food and energy, and climb the ranks of the fight circuit, all while trying to find out who murdered his father.

Each day is a balancing act between working, training and resting, and you choose skills and fighting styles that shape how bouts play out. The pixel art story is packed with references to 80s and 90s movies and games. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy management with a sense of humor.
3241660:
R.E.P.O. is an online co-op horror game for up to six players. You play small robots sent into creepy locations to find valuable objects and bring them back to satisfy your mysterious creator.

Everything is physics-based, so fragile items break if you bump them, and carrying heavy loot often takes teamwork. Monsters roam each level, and proximity voice chat makes every scream and plan part of the fun. Money from each run buys upgrades. The game is in Early Access and is best played with friends.
314810:
Randal's Monday is a point-and-click adventure about a kleptomaniac with terrible habits. After stealing a cursed ring from his best friend, Randal gets trapped in a time loop, reliving the same awful Monday over and over.

To break the curse, you solve puzzles and see how each loop changes the world around him. The game is packed with humor and pop culture references, and Jeff Anderson from the film Clerks voices Randal. It is a single-player adventure for players who love classic puzzle design and offbeat comedy.
1144200:
Ready or Not is an intense tactical first-person shooter. You lead a SWAT team responding to dangerous situations in a modern-day city, from hostage rescues to active shooter calls.

Success depends on planning and discipline. You choose gear, breach doors carefully, issue commands, and arrest suspects when you can, since your actions are scored against police procedure. Missions are tense and realistic. You can play with AI squadmates or with friends in online co-op. It suits players who want a serious tactical game.
1174180:
Red Dead Redemption 2 is an open-world western from Rockstar. You play Arthur Morgan, a member of the Van der Linde gang, as they rob, steal and fight their way across America in 1899.

The world is huge and detailed, with hunting, fishing, side stories and more. The story is emotional and acclaimed. It also includes Red Dead Online. It is one of the best open-world games ever made.
294100:
RimWorld is a sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller. A small group of colonists crash on a distant planet, and you guide them as they build a home, grow food and try to survive.

The game simulates psychology, health, relationships, weather, trade and combat, so every colony produces its own stories of triumph and disaster. Storytellers control how events unfold, from gentle to brutal. Expansions and a massive modding scene add endless variety. It is a single-player game for players who love emergent storytelling.
1421490:
Rise of the Triad: Ludicrous Edition is a remaster of the 90s cult classic first-person shooter, made by Nightdive Studios. You play a member of a special ops team fighting a deranged cult across a heavily fortified island.

The action is fast and over the top, with rocket launchers, magic weapons and wild power-ups. This edition adds 4K and ultrawide support, unlimited frame rates, restored content, new episodes, a level editor and online multiplayer. It suits fans of classic shooters who want the original with modern options.
40300:
Risen is a role-playing game from Piranha Bytes, makers of the Gothic series. Shipwrecked on a mysterious volcanic island, you find yourself caught between rival factions as earthquakes, monsters and ancient ruins appear.

You choose which side to join and how to fight, using swords, staffs or magic, and every action has consequences. The world is handcrafted and atmospheric, with tough combat that rewards learning. It is a single-player game for fans of classic European RPGs who like exploration and a gritty tone.
1155970:
Roadwarden is an illustrated text-based role-playing game with isometric pixel art. You play a roadwarden sent to a remote peninsula, where you have a limited number of days to explore, make the roads safer and decide what kind of person you will be.

The game blends role-playing, visual novel and adventure mechanics, and its rich writing reacts to your choices, reputation and even your manners. Combat and dangers are handled through text and decisions. It suits players who love reading, careful planning and stories that change based on what they do.
241600:
Rogue Legacy is a rogue-lite platformer where anyone can be a hero. Each time you die, one of your children takes over, and every heir comes with unique traits, such as being colorblind, near-sighted or a giant.

The castle changes each time you enter, filled with enemies, traps and bosses. Gold you collect goes toward upgrading your manor, making future generations stronger. It is challenging but rewarding, with steady progress even after failure. It suits players who like action roguelikes with a fun twist.
252490:
Rust is a multiplayer survival game where the only aim is to survive. You wake up on an island with nothing, and everything wants you dead, from wildlife and the weather to hunger and other players.

You gather resources, craft tools and weapons, and build a base to protect your loot. Players form alliances, trade, raid and betray each other, so every server becomes its own story. It is harsh and unforgiving but deeply engaging. It suits players who want high-stakes survival with friends or rivals.
9480:
Saints Row 2 is an open-world crime game from Volition. You play the leader of the Saints, who wakes from a coma and sets out to reclaim the city of Stilwater from rival gangs and corporations.

You can customize your character in detail and approach missions and activities however you want, from insurance fraud to chaotic rampages. The tone is over the top and full of humor. It suits players who want a wild, freeform open-world game.
555880:
Sairento VR is a virtual reality action game where you play a cyber ninja. You can triple jump, wall run, power slide and slow time to dispatch enemies in mid-air before landing to strike another foe.

Weapons include katanas, guns, bows and throwing glaives, and you can customize your loadout. You can play missions solo or with others online, or face other players in combat. You will need a VR headset to play. It suits players who want fast, acrobatic VR combat.
421120:
Samorost 3 is an exploration adventure and puzzle game from Amanita Design. A little space gnome finds a magical flute and travels across space to nine unique worlds full of colorful creatures and surprises.

Each world is a puzzle box. You play the flute to listen to objects and creatures, and solve puzzles by experimenting with everything you find. There is no dialogue, and the music and hand-crafted art carry the story. It is relaxing and suitable for players of all ages.
526870:
Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game. You are an engineer sent to an alien planet by the FICSIT corporation, where you build multi-story factories and conveyor belts to automate production.

As your factory grows, you unlock new technologies, vehicles and power sources, and design complex production chains. Exploration and combat add variety as you search for resources. You can play alone or with friends in co-op. It suits players who love building and optimizing.
1172620:
Sea of Thieves is a pirate adventure from Rare. You and your crew sail a shared world, hunting buried treasure, battling skeletons and sea monsters, and fighting or befriending other players.

You can take voyages from trading companies, explore story-driven Tall Tales and take part in seasonal events. Every trip can turn into an unexpected adventure. It is best played with friends, though solo sailing is also possible. It suits players who want a social, adventurous game.
11550:
Second Sight is a psychological stealth action thriller from Free Radical Design, the team behind TimeSplitters. You play John Vattic, a scientist who wakes up with psychic powers and no memory of how he got them.

You use telekinesis, healing, mind control and astral projection alongside guns and stealth, and the story jumps between the present and the past as you uncover what happened. It is a single-player cult classic for players who like story-driven action with a twist.
814380:
Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is an action adventure from FromSoftware. You play a shinobi called the Wolf, out for revenge and to rescue his young master in a reimagined late Sengoku-era Japan.

Combat is built around parrying and breaking your enemies' posture, and your prosthetic arm adds tools like shurikens and an axe. When you die, you can resurrect and keep fighting. It won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2019 and is a tough, rewarding experience.
522210:
Serial Cleaner is a stylish 2D action stealth game set in the 1970s. You play Bob Leaner, a professional mob cleaner whose job is to tidy up crime scenes and get out before the police notice.

Each level means sneaking past officers to remove bodies, evidence and blood, timing your moves and using hiding spots. Levels can be replayed with new challenges. The funky soundtrack and bold art style give it plenty of character. It suits players who enjoy stealth puzzles with a sense of humor.
1949030:
Sherlock Holmes The Awakened is a detective adventure from Frogwares, rebuilt from the ground up with modern graphics and gameplay. Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate mysterious disappearances that lead them into the terrifying Cthulhu Mythos.

You gather clues, reconstruct events and connect evidence to make your own deductions, while the story grows darker as Holmes faces things beyond logic. It is a single-player game for fans of detective stories and Lovecraftian horror.
2138710:
Sifu is a realistic third-person brawler with tight Kung Fu combat. You play a young martial artist seeking revenge for your master's murder, fighting through gangs and their leaders across a series of locations.

Each time you die, you come back older, stronger but closer to the end, so mastering combat and learning each level is essential. The fighting is deep, with parries, dodges and environmental attacks. It suits players who want a challenging and cinematic martial arts game.
1325890:
Silt is an atmospheric puzzle adventure set in a surreal ocean abyss. You play a lone diver chained in the deep, who can possess sea creatures and use their abilities to solve environmental puzzles.

The black-and-white art creates a haunting mood, and the mystery of what lies below unfolds without words. Some creatures can break walls, others can move fast or light the way. It is a short single-player game for players who enjoy dark, artistic puzzles.
975470:
Silver Chains is a first-person horror game with a strong focus on story and exploration. After an accident, you wake up in an old abandoned manor and search for clues to uncover the truth about the terrible events that happened there.

You explore the house, solve puzzles and piece together the family's history, while a dark presence haunts you. The atmosphere is tense and Victorian. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy story-driven horror.
369070:
Slain: Back from Hell is a heavy metal inspired action game with old-school arcade combat. You play Bathoryn, a warrior brought back to free a gothic land from evil, slashing through hordes of monsters.

Combat is about timing, blocking and parrying, with puzzle elements and plenty of gore. The pixel art is stunning, and the soundtrack is pure metal. It is challenging and atmospheric. It suits players who enjoy classic action platformers.
646570:
Slay the Spire is a roguelike deckbuilder from Mega Crit. You choose a character and climb the Spire, fighting monsters in card-based battles and building a deck as you go.

Every run is different, with new cards, relics and events to discover. Each character plays differently, and the game rewards careful planning and smart choices. It is one of the most influential games in its genre. It suits players who love strategy and replayability.
2868840:
Slay the Spire 2 is the sequel to the iconic roguelike deckbuilder from Mega Crit. You choose a character, craft a unique deck and climb the Spire, facing bizarre creatures and finding relics of immense power.

The sequel brings new characters, cards, relics and events, along with online co-op for climbing with friends. It is in Early Access, with more content being added. It suits fans of the original and anyone who loves deckbuilders.
433340:
Slime Rancher is a life sim from Monomi Park. You play Beatrix LeBeau, a young rancher who moves to a planet far from Earth to make a living wrangling slimes.

You collect slimes with your vacpack, feed them and gather the plorts they produce to sell. Mixing slimes creates new types, and you can expand your ranch and explore new areas. It is colorful and relaxing. It suits players of all ages.
695100:
Smoke and Sacrifice is a survival adventure. Sachi, a mother forced to give up her son as a sacrifice, ventures into a grotesque underworld on a quest that leads to a darker truth.

You gather resources, craft weapons and armor, and fight creatures in a world with a day and night cycle. The hand-drawn art is beautiful and the story is emotional. It suits players who enjoy survival games with a story.
282140:
SOMA is a sci-fi horror game from Frictional Games, the creators of Amnesia. You play Simon, who wakes up in PATHOS-II, an underwater research facility at the bottom of the Atlantic, with no idea how he got there.

There is no combat, so hiding, sneaking and running are your only options as strange machines roam the halls. The story raises haunting questions about consciousness and what it means to be human, and they stay with you long after it ends. It suits players who want thought-provoking horror.
213670:
South Park: The Stick of Truth is a role-playing game from Obsidian Entertainment, written by South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone. You play the New Kid, who joins a kids' fantasy game in South Park that turns into an epic quest.

Combat is turn-based with timing-based attacks, and you can recruit familiar characters. The game looks just like the show. It suits fans of South Park and RPGs.
979110:
Space Haven is a spaceship colony sim from Bugbyte. You lead a ragtag crew of civilians searching for a new home among the stars, building spaceships tile by tile as you go.

You manage oxygen and gas levels, food, power and the moods and relationships of your crew. Along the way you meet other space-faring groups to trade or fight with, board derelicts and explore the galaxy. It suits players who enjoy deep management games in the style of RimWorld with a sci-fi twist.
115110:
Stacking is a puzzle adventure from Double Fine set in a world of Russian nesting dolls. You play Charlie Blackmore, the smallest doll, on a quest to rescue his family from the villainous Baron.

Charlie can hop inside larger dolls and use their abilities, from charming people to breaking down doors. Most puzzles have several solutions, and finding them all is part of the fun. The silent film style adds plenty of charm. It is a single-player game suitable for players of all ages.
651670:
Star Renegades is a rogue-lite strategy role-playing game. You lead a group of rebels across dimensions, fighting uniquely generated adversaries in an attempt to end a cycle of destruction.

Combat is turn-based, with a timeline system that lets you plan attacks and interrupts. Bonds between heroes grow, and each run is different. The pixel art is stunning. It suits players who like tactics and roguelikes.
32370:
Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic is a role-playing game from BioWare. Set four thousand years before the Galactic Empire, you are the last hope of the Jedi Order in a war against the Sith.

You choose your path to the light or dark side, gather companions and explore planets. The story is acclaimed for its twists. It is one of the most beloved Star Wars games ever made. It suits fans of RPGs and Star Wars.
413150:
Stardew Valley is a farming life sim from ConcernedApe. You inherit your grandfather's old farm and start a new life in the countryside, turning overgrown fields into a thriving home with hand-me-down tools and a few coins.

You grow crops, raise animals, fish, mine for treasure and build relationships with the townspeople, even marrying one. Festivals and seasons keep the year interesting, and you can play with friends in online co-op. It is one of the most popular and relaxing indie games ever made.
1716740:
Starfield is a role-playing game from Bethesda Game Studios, the creators of Skyrim and Fallout 4. You join Constellation, the last group of space explorers, in a search for mysterious artifacts across the Settled Systems.

You can visit over a thousand planets, build and customize ships, set up outposts, join factions and shape your character through backgrounds and skills. Combat mixes gunplay with space battles. The Shattered Space expansion adds more story. It suits fans of sci-fi and open-world RPGs.
464880:
Stars in Shadow is a turn-based 4X strategy game and a loving tribute to the classics of the genre. You lead one of several alien factions as it explores nearby star systems, colonizes new worlds and competes with rivals for control of the region.

Ships are designed by you, and battles play out as tactical turn-based fights where positioning and loadouts matter. Each faction has its own style, and diplomacy, research and planet management round things out. Games are shorter and more focused than many 4X titles, which makes it a good entry point for newcomers.
460920:
Steep is an open-world extreme sports game from Ubisoft set across the Alps. You ride huge mountains on skis, snowboards, wingsuits and paragliders, choosing your own lines down peaks where the powder is always fresh.

You can drop anywhere, take on challenges and races, or simply explore and film your best runs. Riding with friends online makes it easy to share stunts and race each other down the slopes. It suits players who want a relaxing, scenic sports game with plenty of freedom.
1622910:
Still Wakes the Deep is a first-person horror game from The Chinese Room set in 1975. Disaster strikes the Beira D oil rig off the coast of Scotland, and you play Caz, an electrician who must navigate the collapsing rig to save the crew from an otherworldly horror.

There are no weapons. You climb, swim, hide and run through cramped, flooding corridors while something terrible stalks the platform. The strong voice acting and Scottish setting give it a grounded, personal feel. It won several BAFTA awards and suits players who enjoy story-driven horror.
1332010:
Stray is a third-person adventure where you play a stray cat. Lost and separated from your family, you must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten city inhabited by robots and dangerous creatures.

You explore neon-lit streets and rooftops, climb, knock things off shelves and interact with the world just like a real cat. A small drone companion called B-12 helps you talk to the robots and solve puzzles. The game is short, charming and beautifully detailed, perfect for cat lovers and adventure fans alike.
1364780:
Street Fighter 6 is the latest entry in Capcom's legendary fighting game series. It offers three distinct ways to play: Fighting Ground for classic matches, World Tour for a story mode where you create your own fighter, and Battle Hub for meeting and fighting other players online.

Modern Controls make special moves easier for newcomers, while Classic Controls keep the traditional inputs for veterans. The Drive System adds new options for offense and defense. With a strong roster, regular additions and excellent online play, it is a great fighting game for both beginners and experts.
264710:
Subnautica is an underwater survival adventure from Unknown Worlds. After crash landing on an alien ocean planet, you must craft equipment, build bases and pilot submarines to survive and find a way home.

You explore coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems and the dark depths, where some of the creatures are friendly and others are terrifying. Oxygen, food and water all need managing as you dive deeper. The story unfolds as you explore. It is a single-player game known for its sense of wonder and fear of the deep.
2124120:
SULFUR is a modern old-school action adventure that blends first-person shooting with roguelite dungeon diving. You descend into dangerous depths, outsmart enemies, find treasure, upgrade weapons and harness strange powers.

Guns can be modded with attachments, and an inventory system makes looting and managing gear part of the challenge. Levels change each time, so every trip down is different. You keep progress between runs as you dig toward the answers waiting below. It suits players who like tough shooters with a loot-driven loop.
962580:
Summer in Mara is a cozy farming adventure set in a tropical archipelago. You play Koa, a young girl who looks after her own island while sailing to nearby islands to trade, explore and help others.

You grow crops, craft items, cook and complete quests for the colorful characters you meet. There is no rush and no combat, so you can relax and play at your own pace. The bright hand-drawn style and calm music add to the mood. It suits players who enjoy gentle life sims with a sense of adventure.
847370:
Sunset Overdrive is an open-world action game from Insomniac Games. An energy drink has turned most of Sunset City into mutants, and you treat the apocalypse as your personal playground.

You grind on rails, bounce off cars and run along walls while blasting enemies with wild weapons like a record launcher and a teddy bear bomb. Staying in motion powers you up, so movement and combat flow together. The humor is loud and silly. It is a single-player game for players who want colorful, high-energy action.
221640:
Super Hexagon is a minimal but intense action game by Terry Cavanagh, with music by Chipzel. You control a small triangle that rotates around the center of the screen, dodging walls that close in from all sides.

The game is extremely fast and challenging, and most runs last only seconds at first. Each level adds faster speeds and trickier patterns. Survival depends on reflexes and memorization. It is a short and very replayable game for players who love testing their skills.
688140:
TEMPEST 4000 is a tube shooter based on the classic arcade game Tempest, created by Jeff Minter of Llamasoft. You move around the edge of geometric tubes, blasting enemies as they climb toward you.

The visuals are psychedelic and colorful, and the music is a pulsing techno soundtrack. There are 100 levels and power-ups to collect, with multiple modes to test your skills. It suits fans of classic arcade games who want an intense and stylish shooter.
105600:
Terraria is a 2D action adventure sandbox where you dig, fight, explore and build. You start with basic tools in a randomly generated world and gradually craft better gear to explore deeper caves and take on tougher enemies.

There are hundreds of items, many bosses and events, and plenty of secrets to find. You can build anything from a small house to huge castles. Years of free updates have added tons of content, and you can play alone or with friends online. It is one of the most beloved indie games ever made.
249590:
Teslagrad is a 2D puzzle platformer set in a long-abandoned tower. You play a young boy who discovers magnetic and electric powers that help him explore the Tesla Tower and uncover its secrets.

You use magnetism to move objects, leap great distances and overcome obstacles, and the puzzles get more complex as you gain powers. The story is told without words, through the hand-drawn art and environment. It suits players who enjoy clever puzzles and atmospheric worlds.
1698220:
Teslagrad 2 is a puzzle platformer from Rain Games. Lumina, a young Teslamancer, is stranded after her airship crash lands in Wyrmheim, a remote and treacherous land in the north.

She explores a gigantic abandoned Tesla Tower and uses magnetic and electric powers to solve puzzles and move fast, including surfing and blinking through obstacles. The hand-drawn world is beautiful and full of secrets. It suits fans of the first game and anyone who likes platformers with clever mechanics.
792300:
The Beast Inside is a psychological thriller and survival horror game. You play two protagonists linked by a dark heritage: a cryptanalyst during the Cold War and a man in the 19th century, whose stories intertwine.

The game mixes exploration, puzzle solving and scares, with sections where you must hide from threats. Long-buried secrets and personal tragedies slowly come to light. It suits players who like story-driven horror with a historical setting.
250900:
The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action shooter with heavy roguelike elements. You guide Isaac through dark basements, fighting monsters with tears and collecting strange items that change how he looks and plays.

There are hundreds of items and many secrets, so each run is different. Expansions have added even more content, characters and endings. The tone is dark and strange, but the gameplay is deep and addictive. It suits players who love challenging roguelikes.
215160:
The Book of Unwritten Tales is a fantasy point-and-click adventure from KING Art. In a world torn by war, an old gremlin archaeologist named Mortimer MacGuffin holds the secret of a powerful artifact.

You play several heroes who team up to find it, including a gnome and an elf princess, solving puzzles and talking to odd characters. The game is full of humor and parodies of fantasy stories. It suits fans of classic adventures with a lighthearted tone.
279940:
The Book of Unwritten Tales 2 is a point-and-click adventure from KING Art. Wilbur, Ivo, Nate and Critter return to the world of Aventasia to fulfill their destinies as heroes.

The game is packed with humor, references and inventive puzzles, and the visuals are bright and detailed. Each character's story weaves into a bigger adventure. It suits players who enjoyed the first game or love comedy adventures.
1432100:
The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales is a narrative adventure. You play Etienne Quist, a writer forbidden to write who now works as a thief, with the ability to dive into books and steal valuable items from the worlds inside them.

You travel between his apartment building in reality and the book worlds, solving puzzles, talking to characters and fighting in turn-based battles. The tone is thoughtful and atmospheric, with questions about who you can trust. It suits players who enjoy story-driven games with a unique premise.
1577250:
The Chant is a third-person horror action adventure. Set on a remote spiritual island retreat, you must survive the psychedelic horrors unleashed when a ritual goes wrong.

You craft weapons from herbs and items, fight monsters and manage your mind, body and spirit. The 70s cult setting and colorful horror make it stand out. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy action horror.
203830:
The Dark Eye: Chains of Satinav is a fantasy point-and-click adventure from Daedalic Entertainment, set in the world of The Dark Eye. You play Geron, a young bird catcher in the kingdom of Andergast, who is drawn into a struggle against a plague of crows threatening a peace treaty.

The game has beautiful hand-painted art and a moving story. You solve puzzles, use a special power to break objects and uncover secrets. It suits fans of story-driven fantasy adventures.
489830:
The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition is the remastered version of Bethesda's legendary role-playing game. You play the Dragonborn, a hero able to absorb the power of dragons, in the northern land of Skyrim.

You can explore freely, join guilds, follow the main quest or create your own path. This edition includes the main game, all three expansions, improved visuals and mod support. It is one of the most acclaimed RPGs ever made, with endless things to do.
1730590:
The Entropy Centre is a first-person puzzle adventure. You wake up in an abandoned research facility orbiting a doomed Earth, armed with a device that can rewind objects back through time.

Puzzles ask you to think in reverse: move a cube onto a switch, then rewind it to build a path, catch a falling platform or block a laser. Your talkative gun keeps you company as the story behind the facility unfolds. It is a single-player game that suits fans of physics puzzles and lighthearted sci-fi.
298630:
The Escapists is a prison escape sandbox. You play an inmate who must follow the daily routine of roll calls, meals and jobs while secretly gathering items and crafting tools to break out.

Each prison has its own layout and security, and there are many ways to escape, from digging tunnels to disguising yourself as a guard. Guards search cells, so you must keep your plans hidden. It suits players who enjoy creative problem solving with a lighthearted, pixel art style.
613470:
The Inner World - The Last Wind Monk is a point-and-click adventure from Studio Fizbin and the sequel to The Inner World. In the hollow world of Asposia, Robert and his friends must save the last wind monk from a dark conspiracy.

The hand-drawn art is full of quirky characters and humor, and you solve puzzles by combining items, talking to locals and switching between playable characters. A built-in hint system helps if you get stuck. It suits fans of classic adventures with a warm, funny tone.
1498570:
