THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV is a fighting game from SNK and the latest entry in its long-running series. You pick a team of three fighters from a large roster of series favorites and battle in fast, combo-heavy matches.

Mechanics like Shatter Strike and MAX Mode give experts plenty of depth, while a story mode, training tools and missions help newcomers learn. Online play uses rollback netcode for smooth matches, and extra fighters have been added after launch. It suits fans of classic 2D fighting games.
1872680:
The Knight Witch is a metroidvania with fast-paced shoot 'em up combat, set in a beautifully hand-drawn world. You play Rayne, a Knight Witch who flies through an underground kingdom to help protect it from a war machine threatening its people.

You fire magic and cast card-based spells drawn from a deck you build, and the bonds you form with other characters make you stronger. Your choices shape the story along the way. It is a single-player game for players who like exploration and twin-stick shooting.
1163060:
The Making of Karateka is an interactive documentary from Digital Eclipse about Jordan Mechner's landmark 1984 game Karateka. It tells the story of how a college student created one of the first cinematic video games.

You move through a timeline of journals, sketches, video interviews and archival materials, and you can play early prototypes and the original versions of the game. A remastered version of Karateka is included too. It suits retro fans and anyone curious about how classic games were made.
764790:
The Messenger is an action platformer from Sabotage. As a demon army attacks his village, a young ninja sets out on a quest to deliver a scroll that is vital to his clan's survival.

It begins as a classic 8-bit platformer, but soon shifts into a 16-bit adventure with time travel, letting you move between eras to explore a bigger world. Controls are tight, the humor is sharp, and a chatty shopkeeper steals the show. It suits fans of retro platformers who like a few surprises.
1304930:
The Outlast Trials is a horror game from Red Barrels set during the Cold War. You are a test subject in the Murkoff Corporation's sinister experiments, and you must survive a series of trials alone or with up to three friends.

You sneak, hide and solve objectives while deranged enemies hunt you, using tools and teamwork to stay alive. Between trials you return to your cell to upgrade and customize your character. The atmosphere is brutal and disturbing. It suits players who enjoy co-op horror and tense stealth.
1266030:
The Pale Beyond is a survival strategy game set on a polar expedition. Your ship is stuck in the ice, the captain is missing and you are miles from civilization, so someone has to take charge, and that someone is you.

You manage meager resources, assign crew to tasks, balance safety against morale and make difficult moral choices that decide who lives. The story reacts to your leadership, with many outcomes. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy tense, narrative-driven management.
2602020:
The Smurfs - Dreams is a 3D platformer where the fate of the Smurf Village depends on what happens in your dreams. You dive into a series of magical dream worlds to save the village from a spell that has put the Smurfs to sleep.

Each dream world has its own theme and challenges, with platforming, puzzles and abilities to unlock. The colorful style suits young players, and you can team up with a friend in local co-op. It is a fun pick for families and Smurfs fans.
916140:
The Tale of Bistun is an action adventure inspired by a classic Persian legend. An amnesiac stone carver climbs Mount Bistun, facing his past and battling legions of monsters on the way to the top.

Combat is fast-paced and melee-focused, mixed with powerful magical abilities, while the story slowly reveals what the carver has lost. The painterly art and music draw on Persian tradition. It is a short single-player game for players who enjoy action and mythology.
835960:
The Talos Principle 2 is a first-person puzzle game from Croteam. You play a robot in a future where humanity is gone, exploring a mysterious megastructure on a remote island and the stunning landscapes around it.

Puzzles grow increasingly mind-bending, using tools such as connectors, drills and gravity devices. The story raises big questions about humanity, progress and belief, discussed with a cast of companions. It greatly expands on the first game and suits fans of puzzles and philosophy.
258520:
The Vanishing of Ethan Carter is a first-person story-driven mystery. You play Paul Prospero, a detective with a supernatural gift, who arrives in a quiet valley to find a missing boy named Ethan Carter.

You explore a beautiful but haunted landscape, find clues and reconstruct crimes to piece together what happened. There is no hand-holding, so your observation drives the story. Buying it gives you both the original and the Redux remaster. It suits players who enjoy atmospheric exploration and mysteries.
210970:
The Witness is a puzzle game from Jonathan Blow, creator of Braid. You wake up alone on a strange island full of puzzles that will challenge and surprise you.

Hundreds of line puzzles on panels teach their rules without words, so learning the language of the island is part of the challenge. The island itself hides secrets that reward careful observation. There are no hints or combat, only discovery. It suits players who love deep, thoughtful puzzles.
518790:
theHunter: Call of the Wild is a hunting simulator from Expansive Worlds. You explore large open-world reserves that react to your every move, from forests to mountains and plains.

You track animals by their footprints, sounds and calls, choose the right weapon and ammunition, and face unscripted encounters with wildlife. The landscapes are beautiful and detailed. You can hunt alone or with friends online. It suits players who enjoy realistic outdoor experiences.
205910:
Tiny and Big: Grandpa's Leftovers is a puzzle platformer with a comic book look. You play Tiny, a nerdy inventor, trying to reclaim his most beloved possession, his late grandpa's underpants, from his rival Big.

Tiny's tools let you slice rocks with a laser, pull them with a grappling hook and push them with rockets, creating your own paths through the desert. The soundtrack features indie bands. It suits players who like creative physics puzzles and quirky humor.
968550:
Tinytopia is a city building game where you construct toy towns on tiny terrain. You place buildings, roads and parks, and combine blocks to create new megastructures.

You can test your skills in physics-based challenge stages, or simply relax and build your dream city. If you want, you can also unleash destruction and watch it all crumble. It suits players who enjoy casual building games with a playful style.
1237970:
Titanfall 2 is a first-person shooter from Respawn Entertainment. In the campaign, rifleman Jack Cooper bonds with BT-7274, a giant robot called a Titan, and the pair fight their way across a hostile planet.

The campaign is praised for its creative levels and memorable moments. Multiplayer mixes fast parkour movement, wall running and Titan combat across many modes. It suits fans of shooters who want both a great story and slick multiplayer.
13540:
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Vegas is a tactical first-person shooter. Rainbow operatives respond to a terrorist attack on Las Vegas, fighting through the streets and casinos of Sin City.

You lead a two-man team, using a cover system that lets you switch between first and third person, rappelling and planning breaches. Commanding your squad is key to success. It suits fans of tactical shooters looking for a classic.
13560:
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell is the stealth action game that launched a legendary series. You are Sam Fisher, an elite covert agent in the NSA's top-secret Third Echelon division.

You use shadows, night vision goggles and gadgets to infiltrate enemy territory, avoid detection and gather intelligence. A light meter shows how hidden you are. It suits fans of stealth games and anyone curious about the series' roots.
235600:
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Blacklist is a stealth action thriller. A terrorist group called the Engineers launches the Blacklist, a series of escalating attacks on US interests, and only Sam Fisher and his Fourth Echelon team can stop them.

You can play as a silent ghost, a nonlethal infiltrator or an aggressive assault specialist, and the game rewards each style. Co-op missions and the Spies vs Mercs mode add variety. It suits fans of the series and stealth action.
13570:
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Chaos Theory is one of the most critically acclaimed stealth action games. Sam Fisher uncovers a conspiracy that threatens to start World War III.

Levels are open, with many paths and gadgets, and Sam can use his knife and interrogation tactics. The lighting and sound design play a big role in staying hidden. It suits fans of stealth games who want a true classic.
2221490:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is an open-world tactical shooter. Seven months after a deadly pandemic struck, you join The Division and travel to Washington, D.C. to save the capital from collapse.

You fight in cover-based combat, take back territory from hostile factions, and build your agent with skills, specializations and loot. You can play solo or team up with friends online, and the endgame and expansions such as Warlords of New York add plenty to do. It suits fans of looter shooters.
3929740:
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow is the second game in the Splinter Cell series. Sam Fisher must uncover a global conspiracy and stop a deadly bio-terror attack threatening the United States.

You infiltrate secure locations around the world, using shadows, gadgets and patience to avoid detection and complete your objectives. New moves and tighter missions build on the first game. It suits fans of the series and anyone who enjoys classic stealth action.
365590:
Tom Clancy's The Division is a tactical open-world third-person shooter set in New York after a deadly pandemic. You play an agent of The Division, activated to restore order against the factions taking over Manhattan.

You can team up with friends or go solo, take cover, use gadget skills and secure better loot. The Dark Zone is a lawless area where players compete for gear, and high-risk endgame challenges await. It suits fans of looter shooters and co-op action.
41500:
Torchlight is an action role-playing game from Runic Games. You explore the randomized depths beneath the boom town of Torchlight, fighting monsters to save the town and possibly the world.

You choose a class, collect loot, level up and bring a pet companion that can fight and sell items. It is easy to learn and fun to play. It suits fans of classic action RPGs.
1011670:
Totally Reliable Delivery Service is a ragdoll physics game about terrible package couriers. Your job is to deliver packages around an open world, and with wobbly controls and unpredictable physics, that is easier said than done.

You and up to three friends can work together using odd machinery, vehicles and gadgets to get packages to their destinations, more or less in one piece. Deliveries often end in hilarious disasters. It suits players who enjoy silly co-op games and slapstick chaos.
647570:
Transference is a first-person psychological thriller made by Ubisoft with SpectreVision. You explore a digital simulation of a troubled family's memories, shifting between three perspectives to unravel the mystery hidden in their past.

It plays like an escape room set in a deranged mind, with puzzles, unsettling sights and a story that reveals itself through clues. It is short and can be played with or without a VR headset. It suits players who like story-driven puzzles and psychological horror.
220160:
Trials Evolution: Gold Edition is a motorbike game from RedLynx and a return of the Trials series to PC. You ride physics-based obstacle courses, balancing your bike to climb ramps, clear gaps and avoid crashing.

Tracks range from easy to brutally hard, and medals reward clean, fast runs. A powerful track editor lets you create your own courses and play ones made by others. It is tough to master but very satisfying. It suits players who like challenging, skill-based racing.
2933200:
Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure. You play Traveller, a forest spirit on a special journey through magical hand-drawn locations, meeting charming characters along the way.

Each area hides handcrafted puzzles to solve and friends to help, and there is no rush or danger, so you can play at your own pace. The art and music create a warm and gentle mood. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy relaxing adventures with lovely visuals.
405820:
Turok is a remaster of the classic 1997 first-person shooter, made by Nightdive Studios. You play the time traveling warrior Turok, thrust into a savage land filled with dinosaurs, monsters and evil forces.

You explore large jungle levels, find keys and use powerful weapons, including the famous Chronoscepter. The remaster improves the visuals and performance for modern PCs while keeping the original feel. It suits fans of retro shooters and anyone curious about this classic.
1649080:
Two Point Campus is a management sim from Two Point Studios, the makers of Two Point Hospital. You build and run a university packed with wild courses, from knight school to gastronomy and wizardry.

You hire staff, design classrooms and dorms, and keep students happy as they study, make friends and attend events. The game is full of humor and charm. It suits fans of management sims and anyone who enjoys building and organizing.
1520760:
Tyrant's Blessing is a tactical roguelike set in Tyberia. The Tyrant has turned the land into a paradise free from war, suffering and death, because nearly everyone has been turned into the undead, and you take charge of the last living warriors.

Battles take place on small grids where every move counts, and positioning, pushing enemies and combining abilities are the keys to winning. You recruit heroes and unlock new options between runs. It is a single-player game for fans of tight, puzzle-like tactics.
468920:
Ultimate Fishing Simulator is a fishing sim where the fish bite like crazy. You travel to many locations and use techniques like spinning, float fishing and ground fishing to catch dozens of species.

The game includes a wide range of rods, reels, lures and bait, plus boats to reach better spots. You can fish alone or with friends online, and compete in tournaments. It is relaxing and detailed. It suits fishing fans and anyone who wants a calm outdoor game.
2711180:
Undead: Rise of the Betrayed King is an action role-playing game with realistic visuals. You play a dragon hiding in the form of a barbarian, fighting the undead with weapons and magic.

Combat companions help you in battle, and a deep progression system lets you shape your character as you grow stronger. The game is in Early Access, so content and features are still being added. It suits players who enjoy dark fantasy action RPGs.
780350:
Unruly Heroes is a co-op action platformer inspired by the classic Chinese tale Journey to the West. You control four unlikely heroes, each with their own fighting style, as they travel west to recover the scattered pages of a sacred scroll.

The hand-painted worlds are stunning, and you switch between heroes to solve puzzles and battle a varied lineup of enemies with kung fu skills. You can play solo or with up to four players in local co-op. It suits fans of colorful platformers.
600130:
Valfaris is a heavy metal 2D action platformer from Steel Mantis, the team behind Slain: Back from Hell. You play Therion, who returns to his home fortress in a far corner of space to find it overrun by evil.

Combat is brutal and fast, combining melee weapons, heavy guns and a shield. Deadly enemies, tough bosses and a thundering metal soundtrack keep the energy high. It is a single-player game for fans of challenging old-school action.
892970:
Valheim is a collaborative exploration and survival game for 1 to 10 players from Iron Gate. You are a fallen Viking warrior sent to a procedurally generated afterlife, where you must prove yourself worthy of Odin's halls.

You gather resources, craft weapons and armor, build longhouses and sail ships to new biomes, each harder than the last. Powerful bosses guard the way forward. It works alone but shines with friends online. It suits players who love survival games with exploration and building.
294860:
Valkyria Chronicles is a tactical role-playing game from SEGA. In a war-torn alternate Europe, Welkin Gunther and Squad 7 defend the small nation of Gallia against an invading empire.

Battles mix turn-based strategy with real-time action, as you pick a unit and directly control them on the battlefield. The watercolor art style looks like a living painting. This PC version includes all previously released extra content. It suits fans of strategy and story-driven RPGs.
70300:
VVVVVV is a platform game from Terry Cavanagh built around one simple idea: instead of jumping, you reverse gravity. You play Captain Viridian, who must rescue the crew of a spaceship scattered across a strange dimension.

Flipping between floor and ceiling makes for clever and challenging rooms, but checkpoints are generous, so failure never takes long to fix. The retro visuals and catchy soundtrack are iconic. It suits fans of tough, precise platformers.
2187290:
Wall World is a roguelite where you explore a mysterious wall that stretches endlessly up and down on a giant robospider. You mine for valuable resources inside the wall and discover exotic biomes as you go.

Between digging trips, hordes of monsters attack, and you defend your robospider with upgraded weapons. Resources fund upgrades that carry over between runs. It is a single-player game for players who like mining, upgrades and action.
1867240:
WARDOGS is a tactical all-out warfare first-person shooter. One hundred players split across three teams fight over a central control zone set in the derelict industrial mountains of Eastern Europe.

The battlefield is destructible, so buildings and cover can change during a match, and teamwork and communication are key to holding ground. The game is in Early Access, with features still being added. It suits players who enjoy large-scale tactical battles.
2183900:
Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 is a third-person action shooter from Saber Interactive. You play Lieutenant Titus, a Space Marine defending the Imperium against relentless Tyranid swarms.

Combat mixes heavy gunfire with brutal melee and executions, against huge waves of enemies. You can play the campaign solo or in co-op with up to two friends, try co-op Operations, or face others in PvP. It suits fans of action and Warhammer.
2186680:
Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is a story-rich classic role-playing game from Owlcat Games, makers of Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous. You play a Rogue Trader, a powerful explorer with your own voidship and a mandate to venture into the Koronus Expanse.

Combat is turn-based and tactical, and your companions each have their own stories and opinions of your choices. Your decisions shape your dynasty and the region. It suits fans of deep RPGs and the Warhammer universe.
3669620:
Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet heaven game from Auroch Digital, the developers of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. You play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes.

You fight through endless hordes of enemies, collecting upgrades that turn each run into a storm of bullets and abilities. Runs are quick and every character plays differently. It is a single-player game for fans of survivors-style games and Warhammer.
447040:
Watch Dogs 2 is an open-world action adventure from Ubisoft set in San Francisco. You play Marcus Holloway, a brilliant young hacker who joins the hacker group DedSec to take down a corrupt system.

You can hack nearly everything in the city, from cars to cameras, using drones and gadgets to solve missions with stealth, chaos or combat. The tone is fun and colorful, and you can team up with a friend in seamless co-op. It suits fans of open-world action games.
312780:
Way of the Samurai 4 is an action adventure set in the port town of Amihama in mid-19th century Japan, just after the arrival of foreign ships ended the country's isolation. You play a wandering samurai who arrives as tensions rise.

You can side with the local government, the foreigners or a rebel group, and your choices shape the story and lead to many different endings. Combat uses a sword-fighting system with many styles. It suits players who enjoy freedom and replayability.
1097110:
Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town is a point-and-click adventure. Willy receives a letter from his father, who disappeared ten years ago, and sets out for an unconventional town of pirates to find him.

You explore, collect items, look for clues and even dive into the past to unravel a web of lies. The colorful art and humor make it fun for all ages. It suits fans of classic adventures with pirates and puzzles.
594130:
Winds of Change is a story-heavy adventure set in a vast fantasy world inhabited by animal folk. You lead a rebellion against a powerful force, building your army and shaping the world with your choices.

The non-linear storytelling offers multiple endings and romance options, and decisions carry weight. It is a single-player game for players who enjoy long, choice-driven visual novel style adventures.
917840:
Wintermoor Tactics Club is a story about surviving high school, with gameplay inspired by tactics RPGs and visual novels. The members of a tabletop gaming club must compete in a school-wide snowball tournament to save their club.

Battles are turn-based tactics fights, while the story unfolds through conversations and choices. The writing is warm and funny. It suits players who enjoy tactics and character-driven stories.
245450:
Wizardry 8 is a classic party-based role-playing game from Sir-Tech. A small group of heroes from distant worlds sets out to reach the Cosmic Circle before vast and mysterious forces seize the power of creation.

You create a party of six, choosing races and classes, and explore a huge world full of factions, quests and turn-based battles. It is considered one of the deepest RPGs of its era. It suits fans of old-school RPGs.
5175310:
Worst Class Ever is an asymmetric party game for up to 8 players. One player is the teacher, and up to seven are mischievous students who blend into dozens of NPC classmates.

Students secretly snack, text and cause trouble, while the teacher tries to catch them in the act. Hiding, pranking and surviving the lesson make every round chaotic. It suits players who enjoy funny party games with friends.
1000410:
WRATH: Aeon of Ruin is a hardcore first-person shooter inspired by the icons of the 90s and built on the legendary Quake engine. Taking place in a realm left to rot, you hunt down the guardians of a dying world.

You blast, slice and shred through enemies with powerful weapons and artifacts, while exploring large, interconnected levels full of secrets. Saving is limited, so careful play matters. It suits fans of classic shooters.
228380:
Wreckfest is a demolition derby themed racing game from Bugbear, the makers of FlatOut. You race and crash through events with soft-body damage that makes every collision feel real.

There are both demolition derbies and more traditional races, with in-depth vehicle upgrades and customization. You can play a career or race online. It suits players who love racing with plenty of destruction.
477740:
Zero Escape: The Nonary Games bundles 999 and Virtue's Last Reward, the first two games in Spike Chunsoft's Zero Escape series. Nine people are kidnapped and forced to play a deadly Nonary Game by a mastermind called Zero.

You solve escape room puzzles and make choices that lead to many different endings, piecing together the truth. The stories are known for their twists. It suits fans of mysteries and puzzle adventures.
311240:
Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma is the final game in Spike Chunsoft's Zero Escape series. Nine participants awaken, trapped in an underground facility, and must play the Decision Game to escape.

The story is told in fragments, with puzzles and life-or-death choices. Who will live and who will die depends on you. It suits fans of the series and dark mysteries.
